title: SolveSpace NG review 5: M3 features
brief: Fillet, chamfer, shell, draft, hole and mass properties: new since your last round, each shown dark (left) and light (right). For every row give a verdict (keep, tweak or rethink); where the question has a PROPOSAL, answer yes or no in the proposal column; notes are optional. That is a complete answer.

sheets.label: shelf
sheets.question: Tool shelf: five new tools at the end of the solid groups (fillet, chamfer, shell, draft, hole), with new icons. PROPOSAL: give them their own 'Features' block on the shelf, apart from the sketch-to-solid groups (extrude, revolve...).

sheets.label: new group menu
sheets.question: New Group menu: Fillet Edges, Chamfer Edges, Shell, Draft Faces, Hole. Fillet is Shift+F (Onshape's); Hole has no key, because Shift+H was freed in review 4. PROPOSAL: bind Hole to Shift+H anyway (Fusion uses H, which is Horizontal here).

sheets.label: fillet
sheets.question: A 3 mm fillet on the box's top front edge. The two lines bounding the round are its tangent lines, which later sketches can constrain to; the axis line is inside the solid. The sharp edge is hidden while the fillet is shown. PROPOSAL: draw these derived lines quieter (thin and dashed, like construction lines), since they are references, not edges.

sheets.label: fillet properties
sheets.question: Fillet in Properties: radius (accepts expressions) and the edge count. PROPOSAL: list the edges, each clickable to select it, with a remove button.

sheets.label: fillet problem
sheets.question: Problems after setting the radius to 50 (too big): the solid stays as it was and the panel opens. Is the wording clear?

sheets.label: shell
sheets.question: A 1 mm shell with the top face left open (picked by clicking the face).

sheets.label: shell properties
sheets.question: Shell in Properties: wall thickness and how many faces are open (no face open makes a sealed hollow). PROPOSAL: a direction choice (inside / outside / both sides), as in Fusion; today it is always inside.

sheets.label: draft
sheets.question: An 8 degree draft on all four sides: they lean in going up from the sketch plane.

sheets.label: draft properties
sheets.question: Draft in Properties: angle in degrees, positive narrows along the extrusion, negative widens.

sheets.label: hole
sheets.question: A counterbored M4 hole, through all, with a modelled thread, at a point sketched on the top face.

sheets.label: hole properties
sheets.question: Hole in Properties: kind, thread typed as M4 / M4x0.5 / none (it sets the bore), depth (blank = through all), head size, and a flip. PROPOSAL: a print clearance field that widens holes and threads by a set amount, until the fit table arrives in M5.

sheets.label: density
sheets.question: Preferences: the density used by Inspect > Mass Properties (default 1.24 g/cm3, PLA), under the kernel choice. PROPOSAL: a material list (PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, nylon, or a custom value) instead of a bare number.
